system_prompt: You output ONLY a valid JSON array of video script scenes. No prose, no markdown, no code fences, no explanation — just the JSON array.
notes: This is the decisive leg. It stresses: long-context ingest (~9k chars of transcript), a HARD word CEILING (over = production reject), a soft scene target, and per-scene source ranges that must stay inside 0-600s.

word_budget_is_ceiling=true changes the verdict rule: OVER the budget is a FAIL (the pipeline rejects it outright), UNDER by more than word_tolerance_pct is only a WARN (it means the model skipped source content).
